items.t: Said many Republicans are fed up with government, especially Trump supporters, and that Biden has motivated them rather than Laura Kelly or Derek Schmidt.
items.q: A lot people are just pretty fed up with government in general, especially the Trump folks," said Tim Shallenburger

items.t: Said he did not see a landslide brewing.
items.q: Shallenburger said, "I don't see a landslide brewing.

record.t: Appeared as an oral proponent of SB98 at a hearing on March 5, 2025.
record.q: | Mar 5, 2025 | View | Senator Tim Shallenburger | District #13 | oral proponent SB98 |

record.t: Served as Kansas state treasurer and as Kansas Republican Party chair.
record.q: said Tim Shallenburger, a former state treasurer and Kansas Republican Party chair.

record.t: Sponsored SB 335, which would require public construction contracts to include a mutual waiver of consequential damages.
record.q: SB 335 , AN ACT concerning public construction contracts; amending the Kansas fairness in public construction contract act; requiring such contracts to include a mutual waiver of consequential damages;

record.t: Sponsored SB 12, which would require approval by each governing body member whose district includes the land before a municipality uses eminent domain for a recreational project.
record.q: SB 12, AN ACT concerning the power of eminent domain; relating to the exercise of such power by municipalities for recreational projects; requiring approval by each member of the governing body whose district territory includes the land being acquired;

record.t: Was the first-listed sponsor of SCR 1615, a resolution honoring Charlie Kirk and recognizing October 14 as Charlie Kirk Free Speech Day.
record.q: SCR 1615 , A CONCURRENT RESOLUTION honoring the life and legacy of Charlie Kirk and recognizing October 14, 2026, and every October 14 thereafter, as Charlie Kirk Free Speech Day, by Senators Shallenburger, Alley, Argabright

record.t: Co-sponsored SB 302, which would prohibit students from using personal electronic communication devices during instructional time, with certain exceptions.
record.q: SB 302 , AN ACT concerning education; relating to school districts and accredited nonpublic schools; prohibiting students from using personal electronic communication devices during instructional time and providing certain exceptions;

record.t: Co-sponsored SB 304, the born to invest act, concerning information on government-administered savings accounts.
record.q: SB 304 , AN ACT concerning the department of health and environment office of vital statistics; relating to information regarding government-administered savings accounts; establishing the born to invest act;

record.t: Co-sponsored SB 10, which would provide property tax exemptions for certain personal property including watercraft, off-road vehicles and certain trailers.
record.q: SB 10, AN ACT concerning property taxation; relating to exemptions; providing exemptions for certain personal property including watercraft, marine equipment, off-road vehicles, motorized bicycles and certain trailers;

record.t: Co-sponsored SCR 1616, a proposed constitutional amendment limiting assessed value increases for real property and mobile homes used for residential purposes.
record.q: SCR 1616 , A PROPOSITION to amend section 1 of article 11 of the constitution of the state of Kansas; relating to property taxation; limiting assessed value increases for real property classified in any subclass and personal property classified as mobile homes used for residential purposes,

record.t: Co-sponsored SCR 1603, a proposed constitutional amendment limiting valuation increases for real property and mobile homes used for residential purposes.
record.q: SCR 1603, A PROPOSITION to amend section 1 of article 11 of the constitution of the state of Kansas; relating to property taxation; limiting valuation increases for real property and for personal property classified as mobile homes used for residential purposes,
